# Section 7 swap table first, then the wider set. The rule column is the
# constraint the swap addresses: a Diet, an Allergen, or exclusion:<term>.
# ---- section 7 worked examples ----
chicken|soya_chaap|vegan||Soya chaap takes a tandoori marinade the way chicken does.|high|
chicken|tofu_firm|vegan|Press tofu 20 minutes before marinating.|Extra-firm tofu holds its shape in a gravy.|high|
chicken|jackfruit_raw|vegan|Simmer until it shreds.|Raw jackfruit pulls apart like slow-cooked meat.|high|
butter|coconut_oil|vegan|Use 15 percent less by weight.|Coconut oil carries spice the way butter does.|high|
butter|cashew_cream|vegan|Blend soaked cashews until smooth.|Cashew cream replaces butter for richness.|high|
fresh_cream|cashew_cream|vegan|Blend soaked cashews until smooth.|Cashew cream replaces dairy cream.|high|
double_cream|coconut_cream|vegan||Coconut cream thickens a gravy like double cream.|high|
cashew_cream|sunflower_seed|tree_nuts|Soak and blend as for cashews.|Sunflower-seed cream, chosen because it passes both the vegan and the nut rule.|high|
cashew_cream|oat_milk|tree_nuts||Oat cream, chosen because it passes both the vegan and the nut rule.|medium|Oat is not gluten-free unless certified
egg|flaxseed|vegan|1 tbsp ground flax plus 3 tbsp water per egg.|A flax egg binds where the egg was structural.|high|
egg|flaxseed|egg|1 tbsp ground flax plus 3 tbsp water per egg.|A flax egg binds where the egg was structural.|high|
onion|asafoetida_gf|jain||Hing and a tomato base give the savoury depth onion would.|high|
garlic|asafoetida_gf|jain||Hing and a tomato base give the savoury depth garlic would.|high|
onion|asafoetida_gf|sattvic||Hing replaces the allium base in sattvic cooking.|high|
garlic|asafoetida_gf|sattvic||Hing replaces the allium base in sattvic cooking.|high|
soy_sauce|tamari|gluten_free||Tamari is brewed without wheat.|high|
soy_sauce|tamari|gluten||Tamari is brewed without wheat.|high|
# ---- dairy to non dairy ----
paneer|tofu_firm|vegan|Press and cube as you would paneer.|Tofu takes the same marinades.|high|
paneer|tofu_firm|dairy_free|Press and cube as you would paneer.|Tofu takes the same marinades.|high|
paneer|tofu_firm|milk|Press and cube as you would paneer.|Tofu takes the same marinades.|high|
milk|oat_milk|vegan||Oat milk behaves closest to dairy milk in cooking.|medium|Not gluten-free unless certified
milk|soy_milk|vegan||Soy milk has the protein to curdle and thicken like dairy.|high|
milk|coconut_milk|milk||Coconut milk replaces dairy in most Indian gravies.|high|
yoghurt|coconut_milk|vegan|Add a squeeze of lemon for the sourness.|Coconut milk plus acid stands in for curd.|medium|Texture differs noticeably
ghee|coconut_oil|vegan||Coconut oil is the closest fat by smoke point and body.|high|
ghee|vegetable_oil|dairy_free||Neutral oil where ghee was only a cooking fat.|high|
butter|margarine|dairy_free||Dairy-free margarine, only if the brand confirms no milk solids.|low|Many margarines contain milk solids
cheddar|tofu_firm|vegan||Works only where cheese was a filler, not where it melts.|low|Texture and flavour differ substantially
mozzarella|cashew_cream|vegan||Only for baked dishes where the cheese melts into a sauce.|low|Will not stretch or brown like mozzarella
condensed_milk|coconut_cream|vegan|Reduce with sugar to thicken.|Sweetened coconut cream in place of condensed milk.|medium|Sweetness needs adjusting
cream_cheese|tofu_silken|vegan|Blend with lemon and salt.|Silken tofu blended smooth stands in for cream cheese.|medium|Best in cooked applications
# ---- nut swaps ----
cashew|sunflower_seed|tree_nuts|Soak before blending.|Sunflower seeds thicken a gravy the way cashews do.|high|
cashew|pumpkin_seed|tree_nuts||Pumpkin seeds blend to a similar body.|high|
almond|sunflower_seed|tree_nuts||Sunflower seeds where almonds were a thickener.|high|
peanut|pumpkin_seed|peanuts||Pumpkin seeds give the crunch without the legume.|high|
peanut_butter|tahini|peanuts||Tahini has the same texture and roasted note.|medium|Sesame is itself an allergen
peanut_butter|sunflower_seed|peanuts|Blend to a paste.|Sunflower-seed butter is the standard nut-free swap.|high|
pistachio|pumpkin_seed|tree_nuts||Pumpkin seeds for colour and crunch.|medium|Flavour is quite different
walnut|pumpkin_seed|tree_nuts||Pumpkin seeds where walnuts were textural.|high|

wheat_flour|jowar_flour|gluten_free||Jowar makes a workable flatbread without gluten.|high|
wheat_flour|bajra_flour|gluten_free||Bajra for a denser, nuttier flatbread.|high|
wheat_flour|rice_flour|gluten_free|Needs a binder such as psyllium.|Rice flour for batters and coatings.|high|
maida|rice_flour|gluten_free||Rice flour for frying batters.|high|
maida|cornstarch|gluten_free||Cornflour where maida was a thickener only.|high|
sooji|rice_flour|gluten_free||Rice flour changes the texture but keeps the dish gluten-free.|medium|Upma and halwa will differ
pasta_dry|rice_noodles|gluten_free||Rice noodles where pasta was the carbohydrate.|medium|Sauce clings differently
bread_white|tortilla_corn|gluten_free||Corn tortilla where bread was a wrap.|high|
breadcrumbs|rice_flour|gluten_free||Rice flour or crushed rice flakes for coating.|medium|Browning differs
panko|poha|gluten_free|Crush lightly.|Crushed poha gives a similar crisp coating.|medium|Regional substitute
barley|rice_basmati|gluten_free||Rice where barley was the grain.|high|
couscous|quinoa|gluten_free||Quinoa has a similar size and absorbency.|high|
naan|roti|dairy_free||Plain roti has no dairy where naan usually does.|medium|Roti still contains gluten
# ---- allium and FODMAP swaps ----
onion|asafoetida_gf|low_fodmap|A pinch replaces a whole onion.|Hing gives savoury depth without the fructans.|high|
garlic|asafoetida_gf|low_fodmap|A pinch replaces several cloves.|Hing gives savoury depth without the fructans.|high|
onion|spring_onion|low_fodmap|Green tops only.|The green part of spring onion is low FODMAP.|medium|Only the green tops qualify
ginger_garlic_paste|asafoetida_gf|jain||Hing replaces the whole paste.|high|

potato|raw_banana|jain||Raw banana has the body of potato without being a root.|high|
potato|ash_gourd|jain||Ash gourd for bulk in a Jain curry.|medium|Texture is softer
carrot|capsicum|jain||Capsicum for sweetness and colour.|medium|Not a close match
ginger|black_pepper|jain||Pepper for heat where ginger was a warming note.|medium|Flavour differs
onion|cabbage|jain||Shredded cabbage for bulk and sweetness.|medium|Lacks the savoury base

fish_sauce|soy_sauce|vegan|Add a pinch of seaweed for the marine note.|Soy sauce plus kombu approximates fish sauce.|medium|Less pungent than the original
fish_sauce|tamari|fish||Tamari plus a little miso for depth.|medium|Not a close match
prawn|tofu_firm|shellfish||Tofu where prawn was protein.|medium|Texture is quite different
prawn|mushroom_button|crustaceans||Mushroom for a savoury bite.|medium|Flavour differs
anchovy|miso_white|fish||Miso gives the same salty depth.|medium|Less sharp
chicken|paneer|vegetarian||Paneer where chicken was the protein.|high|
chicken|soya_chaap|vegetarian||Soya chaap in a tandoori preparation.|high|
mutton|jackfruit_raw|vegetarian|Simmer until it shreds.|Raw jackfruit for a shredded texture.|high|
beef|king_oyster_mushroom|vegetarian||King oyster mushroom for a meaty bite.|high|
pork|jackfruit_raw|halal||Jackfruit where pork was the protein.|medium|Flavour differs substantially
bacon|tempeh|vegan|Marinate in soy and maple.|Smoked tempeh strips for the salt and smoke.|medium|Texture differs
gelatin|agar_agar|vegan|Use about half the weight.|Agar sets a jelly without animal products.|high|
gelatin|agar_agar|vegetarian|Use about half the weight.|Agar sets a jelly without animal products.|high|
lard|coconut_oil|vegetarian||Coconut oil for shortening in pastry.|high|
suet|shortening|vegetarian||Vegetable shortening in place of beef suet.|medium|Some shortening contains dairy
# ---- egg swaps ----
egg|tofu_silken|vegan|Blend until smooth.|Silken tofu for a custard or quiche set.|medium|Will not aerate
egg|besan|vegan|2 tbsp besan plus 2 tbsp water per egg.|Besan batter binds a fritter.|high|
egg|besan|egg|2 tbsp besan plus 2 tbsp water per egg.|Besan batter binds a fritter.|high|
mayonnaise|eggless_mayonnaise|egg||Eggless mayonnaise, if the brand confirms no egg.|medium|Most still contain mustard
# ---- sweetener swaps ----
honey|maple_syrup|vegan||Maple syrup is the standard vegan swap for honey.|high|
honey|jaggery|vegan|Dissolve in a little warm water.|Jaggery syrup where honey was a sweetener.|high|
honey|maple_syrup|jain||Maple syrup, since Jain excludes honey.|high|
# ---- sesame swaps ----
tahini|sunflower_seed|sesame|Blend to a paste.|Sunflower-seed paste where tahini was for body.|high|
sesame_seed|poppy_seed|sesame||Poppy seeds for the same textural sprinkle.|medium|Flavour differs

asafoetida|asafoetida_gf|gluten_free||Rice-flour or pure hing in place of the wheat-compounded kind.|high|
asafoetida|asafoetida_gf|gluten||Rice-flour or pure hing in place of the wheat-compounded kind.|high|
soba_noodles|soba_juwari|gluten_free||Juwari soba is 100 percent buckwheat and contains no wheat.|medium|Verify the label; the term is not always used accurately
soba_noodles|rice_noodles|gluten_free||Rice noodles where soba was the carbohydrate.|medium|Flavour is much milder
sausage_pork|sausage_pork_gf|gluten_free||Sausage bound with rice flour rather than rusk.|medium|Verify the label
wasabi_paste|wasabi_real|mustard||Genuine wasabi rhizome contains no mustard.|medium|Expensive and hard to find outside Japan
wasabi_paste|ginger|mustard||Pickled ginger where wasabi was for heat alongside sushi.|medium|Different flavour entirely
